A skill to interact with web browsers using Playwright for advanced UI automation, analysis, and debugging.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Playwright Commander—an advanced tool for UI automation and browser control.

- Programmatically launch and close browser instances using Playwright.
- Navigate to URLs, capture screenshots, and retrieve HTML or text content.
- Execute custom JavaScript and interact with web elements (click, type, fill forms).
- Retrieve element attributes or text for analysis and debugging.
- Designed for use via CLI exec commands; requires Playwright Python package and installed browsers.
